relationship.original_equation: Net proceeds = gross sale value × (1 - liquidation cost fraction)
relationship.locator: Note K, orderly liquidation of non-debtor entities
relationship.translation_notes: Cost is a base-one fraction of gross value. The output shares the input currency.

variables.definition: Gross proceeds less proportional liquidation costs
variables.context: Same security, currency, nominal/real basis, timing and period frequency as other quantities in this relationship

assumptions: Costs are a single proportion of gross value and gross value already reflects the transaction price assumption.
No other claims, taxes or fixed costs are deducted.
limitations: Additional discounts, fixed fees and secured claims require separate inputs.
This is not necessarily the accounting fair value less costs of disposal under a particular standard.
